name: Haunted by Femboy
source:
In this sandbox visual novel, you unexpectedly inherit a mysterious mansion from your estranged father. After discovering an ancient book, you find that you are now haunted... by a Femboy?! Build your relationship with him while discovering the mysteries kept within the mansion.

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3257270/Haunted_by_Femboy]Steam[/URL]]
